**Resubmitted: deviation (T4C), preferred-level cure.**

Repair made in response to the remaining deterministic failure:
- **Operative wording of the Customer right:** new 18.8 now reads "may terminate this Agreement as to the Customer, and its participation in this Agreement, for convenience", so the Customer convenience right is stated in the standard "terminate this Agreement" form as well as in the consortium's own "participation" idiom. This closes the wording-pattern gap the verifier identified while keeping the right Customer-only and unconditional.

Everything else is unchanged and confirmed:
- 30 days' prior written notice, and a pro-rata refund of charges prepaid for the period after the effective date of termination.
- Counterparty-side element mapped as already_met on the verbatim 18.1 quote (no mid-Initial-Period convenience exit for the other Parties), not re-drafted.
- Single insertion; 18.1, 18.2, 18.4 and 18.7 left verbatim; no survival tail, expense or damages language, or procedure beyond the four checklist elements.
- Noted for negotiation only: 18.4 and 18.7 are keyed to Subparagraph 18.1, so an 18.8 exit sits outside both; any counterparty request to extend those cross-references would be neutral-to-adverse for us.
